name: upload-panel
title: Upload Panel
description: The uploads card pinned bottom-end: a header naming the batch with time left, file and folder rows with progress rings, failures with Retry, interrupted rows with Choose file and destination links, a done card that dismisses itself, a confirm before cancelling, and a bottom sheet on phones. Controlled; the host engine uploads.

meta.whenToUse: Showing every upload in flight across the app — files and folders, progress, time left, failures and where each one lands — from the app shell, so uploads survive navigation.
meta.whenNotToUse: Choosing files (UploadDialog, Dropzone), an attachment inside a composer (Attachment), or a one-off short save (a toast).
